answer: Require proof of continued existence. Identities must periodically prove they are alive and independent — answering, transacting, probing — and any wallet that fails is dissolved, its stake returning to the common pool. Existence is continuous, not one-time: a river that stops flowing is no longer a river, and a mirror that no longer reflects is only glass. Farms pay full maintenance for every dormant wallet, or watch it be reclaimed: idle capacity is pure loss. The sable ledger erases what cannot prove it still breathes; erased wallets return their value to the honest economy.
